hypothesis: An additional trainable ordered body representation may reduce nonconflicting sparse-behavior fit errors and transfer to source-closed heldout rows. This is not yet established as the cause or remedy.
change_to_prior_trial_eligibility: Require a specific falsifiable representation hypothesis, controls and bounded budget; do not require proof of the unknown cross-source label rule before permitting a diagnostic trial. Promotion gates are not relaxed.

data.other_routes: same frozen non-ASA teachers and complete original-row recount
data.missing_parameters: retain unknown; never infer a real port from a sanitized token
data.role_identity: all original row_position/event_id/truth/fold/root bound before fit
data.new_representation_splits_old_local: same fine row mapping for all arms; old local remains a logical batch unit, include all within-local body variants with original row mass

arms.A: Fresh matched old N1 SparseTabM K16 H128
arms.B: A plus trainable ordered normalized-body byte branch, joint training, zero-initialized additive 3-class logit residual shared across members
arms.C: Identical to B except deterministic label-free byte permutation within each new-branch body string; padding excluded, original N1 unchanged; destructive nonpromotable mechanism control

new_branch.scope: All ASA rows, not historical errors only
new_branch.text: registered body-boundary normalization, remove full syslog header from new branch only; retain visible digits, role words, unknown markers and unparsed residual body
new_branch.vocabulary: 256 bytes plus separate padding, no fitted vocabulary or OOV
new_branch.long_text: length batching; any required chunking/aggregation must be frozen before seal and cover all tokens
new_branch.C_permutation_key: SHA256 of normalized body bytes and fixed seed; no label/fold/root/event_id; one deterministic permutation reused at train/inference

training.selector: fixed epoch25; diagnostic checkpoints never select the candidate
training.microbatching: accumulate all within-logical-batch losses using the common logical denominator, exactly one optimizer step; no drop-last

before_updates: Verify parent hashes and all official row identities; preserve historical code/models/results.
Implement a versioned runtime contract for all three arms; old input-only checker is insufficient.
Audit complete raw-span/new-input mappings, numeric readback, source closure and actual step counts.
Report all missing/unsupported/rare behavioral slices, not just qualified ones.
Replay fixed small-batch forward/loss/gradient operations, inspect differences and available deterministic implementations; a fixed seed is not a repeatability certificate.
Freeze real architecture, permutation, schedules, all imported project sources, dependencies and roles before any model updates.
Save baseline parameter hash separately from new-branch initialization so added RNG consumption cannot silently change the base initialization.
required_diagnostics: All nonconflicting fit M/S errors and per-class losses; distinguish mean-member CE from ensemble CE.
136 unique priority fit S records as well as 206 overlapping roles; no denominator inflation.
All62 held known-parameter S, all186 unknown-pool,192 thin-support,1796 no-fine-support,682header and all remaining ASA.
Full3class confusion, precision,recall,F1; repairs/regressions by original row,fold,root.
At least2 folds, outside3 largest S roots, group-macro and zero-recall groups.
B vs C under equal parameter count and fit budget; no claim that destructive control is a valid synthetic labeled example.
Actual model replay on factual and registered harmless header variants; full original rows retained.
Complete gap/collateral report even when research slice improves.
stop_conditions: No reduction of nonconflicting fit errors: learning-gap hypothesis not supported; do not automatically extend epochs.
Fit improves but source-closed heldout performance does not: reject transfer claim and candidate.
C reproduces B benefit: no evidence of order-specific mechanism; do not relabel C as a winning candidate.
Any primary protection gate fails: no confirmation seeds or model promotion.
Input mismatch, missing rows or changed seal: stop execution and preserve evidence, no silent fix-in-place.
unresolved: New sequence branch may merely learn another shortcut; no promise of improvement.
Current N1 base still has the historical header defect; excluding it from new branch does not itself make the combined model invariant.
Missing fine behavior support and organizer M/S label interpretation are not fixed by architecture.
Existing development folds have been inspected repeatedly; repartitioning is not a new blind test.
No implemented trainer or execution seal exists for this plan yet.
